lessons.title: Origins — South Side Chicago, Arts Programs, Father Influence

body.text: Programs, Father Influence Goals: Give context to his worldview. “What do you hear about Chicago in his voice?” Chance = goofy/warm but CHI to the bone.

body.label: Key points
items: Grew up in South Side Chicago (NOT drill culture, but around it)
Dad in politics → early civic awareness
Inspired by Kanye West, Kids These Days, Lupe Fiasco
High school poetry & open-mic scene (Young Chicago Authors)
Suspension from school → wrote first mixtape
